entities.summary: Maurice Jean François Deprez was a Belgian ice hockey player. He was the top scorer at the Ice Hockey European Championship 1913, where his team won the gold medal; he finished third at the 1910 and 1914 European Championships and fifth at the 1920 Summer Olympics.
